run_supernet_training: run the Trainer class to train a super-network on CIFAR-10 with cosine annealing LR and gradient clipping
propose_nasnet_mask: propose a random NASNet architecture mask using sampled_nets_generator on the base super-network
infer_with_mask: infer validation accuracy and loss for the super-network given normal and reduce operation masks
train_single_epoch: train the super-network for one epoch using randomly sampled masks and SGD with gradient clipping
load_checkpoint_model: load a saved model checkpoint including optimizer state, scheduler, and epoch from a file path
